kpis.s: 4 per airfoil, one in each band

cfd_note: Lift within 0.5 %, drag at zero lift within 1 %; at high lift the drag reads ~14 % high on this 20k-cell grid (the far field at 25 chords instead of 200 gave +48 %, which is why it is at 200). The same grid topology is used for every design, so the error is shared and the ranking holds.
validation: OpenFOAM, NACA 2412 (the Cessna 172 airfoil): zero-lift angle -2.0° and lift slope 0.110 per degree, against −2.1° and ~0.105 in the NACA wind-tunnel data (Abbott & von Doenhoff)
OpenFOAM against NASA's turbulence-model validation (NACA 0012, Re 6 million, SST): zero-lift drag 0.00812 vs ≈0.0081, lift at 10° 1.086 vs ≈1.09
